meta.title: AnyPress store template v1.1.5 preview
meta.author: hamchowderr
meta.description: AnyPress theme 0.7.0 and AnyPress Blocks 0.3.0 with WaaS Client 2.4.0: site details on every kit, synced patterns with overrides, wide and sidebar templates, and the MCP Adapter switch.

steps.data:
<?php
// Preview only: makes WaaS Client behave as on an AnyPress store (the Your plan page, plan-managed plugins).
putenv('WAAS_IS_TENANT=true');
define('WAAS_TENANT_ROLES', 'everything');

<?php
// Preview only: what composer's autoloader does for WaaS Client (PSR-4, no other packages).
spl_autoload_register(function ($class) {
    if (strncmp($class, 'WaaSClient\\', 11) !== 0) return;
    $file = __DIR__ . '/../src/' . str_replace('\\', '/', substr($class, 11)) . '.php';
    if (is_file($file)) require $file;
});
